d:
Hamari skin hamen duniya se jorti hai aur hamari sima aur suraksha-kavach bhi banti hai. ye bayotop hai, aakarshan ka kendr hai aur hamare sharir ki gandh bhi tay karti hai. skin ko svasth kaise rakhen aur bimar parne par ise kaise thik karen?
Skin austan karib do varg mitar men phaili aur panch se das kilo vazni hoti hai. lanbe samay tak ise sirf sharir ki bahri parat mana gaya. lekin ye bahumukhi ang usse kahin zyada hai. ye hamen sparsh ka ehsas deti hai, hava se sidhe oksijan leti hai aur saund vevs aur gandh ke anuon ko mahsus kar sakti hai.
